name: AITK-watercolor sketch
description: AITK-watercolor sketch Lora: Bringing an Artsy Touch Introducing AITK-watercolor sketch , a new Lora designed to take on a more artistic, watercolor-sketch style. This Lora aims to address the overly photorealistic tendencies of Flux, pushing it toward a more “artsy” direction. It was trained using a combination of my own artwork and some artificial data created with the MidJourney --sref feature. Although I’m not 100% satisfied with it yet (Flux sometimes seems determined to resist this style!), the results are still really good, and I’m definitely enjoying the vibe it brings. It’s a style I’m digging, and I’d love to see what you all think about it. Feel free to test it out, and please post some of your images on this page—I’d love to see what you’re creating with it!
